Declaration
I, ________________________, Son/daughter/wife of _______________________,
residing at _________________________________________________________ (Full
Address), hereby declare that:
1. I have no criminal record and have never been convicted, arrested, or charged for
any offense under the Indian Penal Code (IPC), POCSO Act, Juvenile Justice Act, or
any other law related to crime against children or any other criminal offense.
2. I affirm that all information provided in this application is true, accurate, and
complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.
3. I understand that if any false, misleading, or misrepresented information is found
in my application or during the course of my engagement, my candidature shall be
cancelled, my empanelment terminated, and I shall be liable for legal action under
application laws.
4. I also consent to a police verification/background check as required for my
selection as a Support Person.
I make this declaration with full understanding and in good faith.
